lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast white vertical segments; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-torso region with increased width between the first and second anterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior-most line terminates significantly before the ventral midline; posterior-most line segments on the haunch are abbreviated.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of approximately 5-6 high-contrast white spots located on the lateral posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally; no continuous geometric lines formed.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white transverse bands on the upper segments of all four limbs; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek area.
